nav.takAdminHint: TAK Server's own administration, opens in a new tab

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Enter your e-mail address and we will send you a one-time code. There is no password to remember.
login.haveCodeIntro: Enter the 6-digit code you were given for {{email}}.
login.codeIntro: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. It is valid for {{minutes}} minutes.
login.codeSent: A new code is on its way.
login.codeAlreadySent: A code was just sent to this address: enter it below.

home.title: My teams
home.description: A team is a group on the TAK server: its members see each other, and nobody else sees them, except the teams it shares an event with, for the duration of that event.

empty.title: You are not in a team yet
empty.description: Without a team, an account has no access to the TAK server. There are two ways to get one:
empty.invited: A team leader invites you with this e-mail address: the invitation then appears on this page.
empty.request: You request a new team: an administrator reviews the request, and you become its leader.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.text: {{inviter}} invites you to join the team {{team}}.
invitations.joined: You are now a member of {{team}}.

request.title: Request a team
request.description: An administrator reviews each request. Once it is approved, you invite the members yourself.
request.name: Team name
request.nameHelp: It also names the team's channel in ATAK and iTAK.
request.modeHelp: You can change this later in the team's settings. In either mode, the team leader can also add external accesses for people who have no account here.
request.sent: Request sent. You will receive an e-mail when it is reviewed.

shared.name: Shared identity
shared.description: One TAK account and one zip for the whole team. Simple to hand out; if a phone is lost or a member leaves, the access is regenerated for everyone.

individual.name: Individual accounts
individual.description: One TAK account per member, created and revoked one by one. Each member sets up their own devices.

team.notFound: This team does not exist, or you are not a member of it.

pending.title: Waiting for an administrator
pending.text: This team has been requested but not approved yet. Members and TAK accesses become available once it is approved.

rejected.title: This request was not approved
rejected.text: You can delete this request and send a new one.

suspended.title: This team is suspended
suspended.text: An administrator has suspended this team: its members are disconnected from the TAK server until it is reactivated.

access.title: Access to the TAK server
access.sharedNotReady: The team leader has not created the team access yet.
access.pendingSync: The access is saved but could not be sent to the TAK server yet. It will be retried automatically within a minute.
access.externalPlaceholder: Name of the person or partner
access.externalHelp: For someone who has no account on this platform. They connect to the team's channel like any member.

members.title: Members
members.removeText: {{name}} leaves the team. Their individual TAK access is revoked at once and their devices are disconnected.
members.leaveText: You leave {{team}}. Your individual TAK access is revoked at once and your devices are disconnected.
members.inviteHelp: The person signs in with this address and finds the invitation on their home page. The e-mail language only applies if they have not chosen one yet.
members.full: The team has reached its limit of {{cap}} members, pending invitations included. An administrator can raise it.
members.invitedNoMail: Invitation saved, but the e-mail to {{email}} could not be sent. Tell them to sign in: the invitation is waiting for them.

settings.title: Settings
settings.modeHelp: External accesses can be added in either mode.
settings.modeLoss_one: {{count}} existing access does not fit this mode: it will be revoked and its devices disconnected.
settings.modeLoss_other: {{count}} existing accesses do not fit this mode: they will be revoked and their devices disconnected.
settings.deleteHelp: Removes the team, its members and every TAK access of it.
settings.deleteConfirmText: Every TAK access of the team is revoked and its devices are disconnected. This cannot be undone.

access.description: Three ways to set up ATAK or iTAK. The zip never contains a callsign, a team colour or a role: the device keeps its own.

sharedNote.title: One identity for the whole team
sharedNote.text: Every device of the team uses this access. Channel switches are shared too: a channel turned off on one device is turned off for all.

port.label: Server port
port.qrHelp: If port {{port}} is blocked on the device's network, choose an alternative port: the iTAK QR code uses it.
port.zipHelp: If port {{port}} is blocked on the device's network, choose an alternative port: the zips use it.

qr.atakHelp: Scan it from ATAK. It carries the server address, the username and the password.
qr.atakOtherPort: Scan it from ATAK. It carries no port: ATAK connects on {{atakPort}}, not {{port}}. Prefer a zip, or change the port in ATAK's server settings after scanning.
qr.itakHelp: Scan it from iTAK, then enter the username and password of the third tab.
qr.warning: Anyone who sees the ATAK code can connect as this account: show it, do not send it. QR codes only work when the server's enrollment port has a publicly trusted certificate; otherwise use the zip file.

zip.certificateHelp: The device connects as soon as the file is imported, without typing anything. The file is a key: hand it over like a password.
zip.enrollmentHelp: The device asks for the username and password, then obtains its own certificate from the server.
zip.note: Import the file in ATAK or iTAK (Import, then pick the zip).

manual.help: For a manual setup: add a TAK server with this address and port over SSL, tick “Enroll for client certificate”, and enter the username and password.
manual.alternativeHelp: If port {{port}} is blocked on the device's network, use one of the alternative ports instead.

certificates.summary_other: {{count}} active certificates, the first one expires on {{date}} ({{relative}}).

regenerate.title: Regenerate this access?
regenerate.text: Every certificate of this access is revoked and its password is changed. The devices using it are disconnected at once and must be set up again with the new QR code or zip.
regenerate.sharedText: Every certificate of the team's shared access is revoked and its password is changed. All the team's devices are disconnected at once and must be set up again with the new QR code or zip.
regenerate.done: Access regenerated. Hand out the new QR code or zip.

remove.title: Remove this access?
remove.text: Its certificates are revoked, its devices are disconnected at once, and its account is deleted from the TAK server. This cannot be undone.
remove.pending: Access removed. The TAK server could not be reached: the revocation will be applied automatically as soon as it answers.

events.title: Cross-team events
events.description: During an event, your team and the other participating teams see each other on the TAK server through a dedicated channel. It appears on the devices at the start and disappears at the end, by itself. Outside events, teams never see each other.
events.descriptionOutside: During an event, the participating teams see each other on the TAK server through a dedicated channel. It appears on the devices at the start and disappears at the end, by itself. Outside events, teams never see each other.
events.sharedNote: Your team uses a shared identity: an event applies to all its devices at once, and a channel switched off on one device is switched off for all of them.
events.noneLeader: Create one, then invite the teams you want to work with.
events.noneMember: Team leaders create events and answer the invitations of other teams.
events.channel: Channel in ATAK and iTAK during the event:
events.pendingSync: Saved, but the TAK server could not be reached: the change will be applied automatically within a minute.

cancelReason.host_deleted: Cancelled because the host team was deleted.

form.timeZone: Dates and times are in your time zone ({{zone}}). Each person sees them in their own.
form.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.

create.title: New event
create.description: {{team}} hosts the event. You then invite the other teams; each team leader accepts or declines. No administrator is involved.
create.name: Event name
create.nameHelp: It also names the channel shown in ATAK and iTAK during the event.
create.created: Event created. Invite the teams that take part.

invitation.title: Invitations to events
invitation.text: {{host}} invites your team to the event “{{event}}”.
invitation.first: No other team has accepted yet.
invitation.effect: If you accept, your members and theirs see each other on the TAK server for the duration of the event.

invite.label: Invite a team
invite.done: {{team}} is invited. Its leaders receive an e-mail.

removeTeam.title: Remove {{team}} from the event?
removeTeam.text: If the team takes part, its members stop seeing the other teams, and being seen by them, at once. Its leaders are told by e-mail. You can invite it again later.
removeTeam.done: {{team}} is no longer in the event.

dates.title: Change the dates of “{{event}}”
dates.description: The channel appears and disappears at the new dates. The leaders of the participating teams are told by e-mail.
dates.running: The event has started: only its end can change. The leaders of the participating teams are told by e-mail.

end.title: End “{{event}}” now?
end.text: The event's channel disappears from every device at once and the teams stop seeing each other. This cannot be undone.

cancel.title: Cancel “{{event}}”?
cancel.text: The event will not take place. If it is running, its channel disappears from every device at once and the teams stop seeing each other. The leaders of the teams concerned are told by e-mail. This cannot be undone.

leave.title: Leave “{{event}}”?
leave.text: Your members stop seeing the other teams, and being seen by them, at once. The host team is told by e-mail and can invite you again.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: How you appear to the members of your teams, the language of this site and of the e-mails you receive, and whether this site is light or dark.
profile.displayNameHelp: Shown to the members of your teams instead of your e-mail address.
profile.languageHelp: Also used for the e-mails sent to you.
profile.themeHelp: Auto follows the light or dark setting of your device. Saved as soon as you pick it.

admin.title: Administration
admin.description: Approve team requests, set member limits, keep an eye on events, and check that the TAK server matches this platform.

teams.title: Teams
teams.suspendText: The team's group is removed from the TAK server: its devices are disconnected and see nobody until the team is reactivated. Accounts and certificates are kept.

events.description: Teams create and run their events themselves; nothing here needs approval. You can cancel an event: its channel then disappears from the TAK server at once.

accounts.description: Anyone can sign in, but an account without a team can do nothing and has no access to the TAK server.

sync.title: TAK server sync
sync.description: This platform's database is the reference. Every {{seconds}} seconds, after each change, and at the start and the end of each event, the directory read by the TAK server is compared with it and corrected.
sync.journalHelp: What the checks changed. “Drift” marks a difference this platform did not cause itself: someone or something modified the directory or the TAK server directly.

kinds.foreign_member_removed: Unknown member removed from the group
kinds.groups_refreshed: Groups pushed to the connected device

triggers.schedule: Start or end of an event

alerts.resolvedTitle_one: {{count}} alert resolved in the last 7 days
alerts.resolvedTitle_other: {{count}} alerts resolved in the last 7 days
alerts.reminder_one: An alert is announced once, recalled every hour while it lasts, and announced again when it is over.
alerts.reminder_other: An alert is announced once, recalled every {{count}} hours while it lasts, and announced again when it is over.

channels.email: Sent by e-mail to every administrator
channels.webhookFailing: posted to the webhook (the last attempt failed)

kinds.agent_unreachable: The host agent does not answer: the server and the services are no longer watched.
kinds.service_unhealthy: The service {{subject}} runs but fails its health check.
kinds.service_restarting: The service {{subject}} keeps restarting ({{restarts}} restarts in the last 15 minutes).
kinds.tak_process_down: TAK Server's "{{subject}}" process is not running.
kinds.reconciliation_failing: The synchronisation with the directory and TAK Server has not succeeded for {{minutes}} minutes.
kinds.event_not_started: The event "{{event}}" should have started {{minutes}} minutes ago and has not: its teams do not see each other yet.
kinds.event_not_ended: The event "{{event}}" should have ended {{minutes}} minutes ago and has not: its teams still see each other.
kinds.client_certificates_expiring: Client certificates expiring within {{days}} days: {{count}}, of which {{urgent}} within {{urgent_days}} days.
kinds.backup_stale: No backup has been made for {{hours}} hours.
kinds.security_updates: Security updates waiting to be installed on the server: {{count}}.
kinds.reboot_required: The server must be restarted to finish installing updates.
kinds.mail_failing: E-mails are not going out ({{count}} failed in the last hour).
kinds.clock_unsynchronized: The server's clock is not synchronised: events may start and end at the wrong time.

subjects.intermediate_ca: the intermediate certificate authority (signs the client certificates)
subjects.platform_api: the platform's access to TAK Server
subjects.tak_admin_ui: the access to TAK Server's administration pages

monitoring.title: Monitoring
monitoring.description: The server, the services, TAK Server, certificates and backups, as the platform last saw them.
monitoring.starting: The platform has just started: its first look is in progress. This page fills in by itself in a few seconds.

agent.disabledTitle: This platform runs without its host agent
agent.unreachableTitle: The host agent is not answering
agent.text: The server, the services and the backups cannot be read, and services cannot be restarted from here, until it is back. The platform itself keeps working, and what it checks on its own (TAK Server, certificates, synchronisation, e-mail) is still shown below. On the server:
agent.commandLabel: the command that starts the agent

updates.title: System updates
updates.unknownSystem: Unknown: this server does not run Debian or Ubuntu, the systems whose package state the platform knows how to read.
updates.listsAge: From the package lists the server downloaded {{when}}.
updates.listsStale: They are more than a week old: this count may be out of date.
updates.howTo: The platform never installs updates and never restarts the server. Over SSH:

services.title: Services
services.description: The containers of this platform, and nothing else that runs on the same server.
services.dockerError: Docker did not answer the agent
services.updateHelpTitle: What “newer image” means, and how to update
services.updateHelp: Every image is pinned. For an image pulled by its tag (Caddy, PostgreSQL, the mail catcher), “newer” means the registry now serves another image under the same tag: a patch release or a rebuild. The directory's image is pinned to one exact build on purpose; a newer build is shown for information, and moving to it is a change of the Compose file to test first. The images built on this server follow the TAK Server version and this repository. Registries are asked twice a day at most. The platform never pulls an image by itself; over SSH:
services.updateCommandLabel: the command that updates the images
services.updateAvailable: A newer image is available for at least one service.

restartText.takserver: Every TAK client is disconnected. TAK Server takes about a minute to be back; the clients then reconnect by themselves.
restartText.takserver-db: TAK Server loses its database for a few seconds. Connected clients normally stay connected; anything it was writing at that moment may be lost.
restartText.postgres: The platform's database stops for a few seconds: this site answers with errors meanwhile. TAK clients are not affected.
restartText.openldap: The directory stops for a few seconds. Connected TAK clients stay connected; a device enrolling at that moment has to try again.
restartText.app: This site stops answering for a few seconds, then comes back. TAK clients are not affected.
restartText.caddy: This site becomes unreachable for a few seconds, then comes back. TAK clients are not affected.
restartText.other: The service stops for a few seconds and starts again.
restartText.mailpit: The mail catcher stops for a few seconds and forgets the messages it holds.

services.restartAccepted: {{service}} is restarting: this page may stop answering for a moment.

tak.title: TAK Server
tak.notAnswering: Its API does not answer the platform
tak.processesUnknown: Its processes could not be listed.
tak.newerTitle: TAK Server {{version}} is available on tak.gov
tak.newerText: Download its “docker hardened” ZIP, put it at the root of the repository on the server, and follow “Upgrading TAK Server” in the README.
tak.zipTitle: A ZIP of TAK Server {{version}} is at the root of the repository
tak.zipText: The upgrade can be run. It takes a backup first, builds the new images, and restarts TAK Server. Read “Upgrading TAK Server” in the README before; over SSH:
tak.versionHelp: tak.gov cannot be asked automatically. When you see a newer version there, record it in the settings: this page will then remind you. A ZIP of another version placed at the root of the repository is noticed by itself.

certs.title: Certificates
certs.description: A certificate is announced {{warning}} days before it expires, and again {{critical}} days before.

name.platform_api: The platform's access to TAK Server
name.tak_admin_ui: Access to TAK Server's administration pages

certs.stale: as presented before it stopped answering
certs.clientsHelp: Nothing renews a client certificate: the access must be regenerated and its zip handed out again. The leaders of the team are told by e-mail for the certificates shipped in a zip.

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: What the platform does in the background: keeping the directory in line, applying the events, sending e-mails.
platform.scheduleOk: starts and ends applied on time
platform.eventNotEnded: “{{event}}” should have ended {{when}}: its teams still see each other.
platform.mailFailuresValue: {{hour}} in the last hour, {{day}} in 24 hours

release.title: TeamTAK version
release.updateText: Read what it changes, then update over SSH from the root of the repository: the command below takes a backup, gets the new version and applies it (“Updating TeamTAK” in the README).
release.help: GitHub (github.com/{{repository}}) is asked twice a day for the latest release, every hour while it does not know the installed one yet; “Check again” asks it at once. An alert says when a newer one is published. Nothing is updated from the web UI.
release.checkFailed: GitHub did not answer; the reason is shown under the version.

letsencrypt.noCertificate: The enrollment port waits for a Let's Encrypt certificate: Caddy has none yet.
letsencrypt.handedOver: The enrollment port (8446) presents the Let's Encrypt certificate.
letsencrypt.pending: The Let's Encrypt certificate was renewed and is not yet given to the enrollment port (8446).
letsencrypt.updated: The certificate was handed over; TAK Server was restarted.
letsencrypt.unchanged: The certificate has not changed: nothing to do.

charts.title: History
charts.description: One measure a minute, for the machine and for each service, kept {{days}} days; then one an hour, its average and its highest minute, kept {{years}} years.
charts.points_other: Each point is the average of {{count}} minutes; the light band rises to the highest of them.
charts.pointsHours_one: Each point is the average of an hour; the light band rises to its highest minute.
charts.pointsHours_other: Each point is the average of {{count}} hours; the light band rises to their highest minute.
charts.customInvalid: The end must come at least a minute after the start.
charts.hint: Point at a chart to see that moment on every chart; drag across it to zoom in.
charts.combinedHelp: Each curve is drawn against its own highest over the period (100 %), so measures of different units can be compared; the legend gives the real values and hides or shows each curve.

serviceMetricHelp.cpu: Share of the whole server's processor, all cores together: the services add up to about the server's figure.
serviceMetricHelp.memory: Memory each service uses, without the file cache the system can take back.
serviceMetricHelp.disk: Space each service's data takes: its volumes and its folders under deploy/data.

charts.sameScale: Same scale for every service, up to {{value}}.
charts.noServices: No measure by service over this period.
charts.chartLabel: Chart: {{title}}. Arrow keys show each measure, + zooms in, − zooms out.
charts.empty: The history starts a minute after the platform's first start.

devices.adminDescription: Every device connected to TAK Server right now, with the access it uses.
devices.teamDescription: The devices connected to TAK Server right now with the accesses of this team. Only the team's leaders, and the administrators, see this list.
devices.teamDescriptionShared: The devices connected right now with the team's shared identity and its other accesses. With a shared identity this list is the only way to know how many devices use it. Only the team's leaders, and the administrators, see it.
devices.notYet: TAK Server has not answered yet.
devices.noneInTeam: No device of this team is connected.
devices.unidentifiedHelp: TAK Server lists these without their account: they belong to no channel (a suspended team, a removed access) and see nobody. It also keeps listing a session for a while after its device is gone.

backups.title: Backups
backups.description: One archive holds everything needed to rebuild the platform: its database, the directory, TAK Server's database, the certificate authority and the settings.
backups.confirmEncrypted: A new archive is written to the backup folder of the server, encrypted with the passphrase saved in the settings. Nothing is stopped.
backups.confirmPlain: A new archive is written to the backup folder of the server. It is not encrypted and holds every secret of the platform. Nothing is stopped.
backups.failed: The backup failed. Its error is in the list of runs.
backups.noAgentText: The agent writes the archives. Without it no backup is made, automatic or not, and the archives on the server cannot be listed here.
backups.notEncryptedText: They hold every secret of the platform: whoever reads one can sign certificates for your TAK Server. Set a passphrase in the settings, and keep a copy of it elsewhere.
backups.encrypted: with the passphrase of the settings
backups.dailyLogs_one: TAK Server logs: {{count}} file cleaned, {{size}} left.
backups.dailyLogs_other: TAK Server logs: {{count}} files cleaned, {{size}} left.
backups.dailyPurged_one: {{count}} old row deleted from the platform's history tables.
backups.dailyPurged_other: {{count}} old rows deleted from the platform's history tables.
backups.runsHelp: Each backup asked of the agent, by the daily schedule or by an administrator.
backups.restoreHelp: A restore replaces everything on the server with the content of one archive. It is run over SSH, never from here, and asks for confirmation.
backups.restoreNote1: Copy the archives off the server: a backup that only lives on the disk it protects does not survive that disk. The file docs/backups.md in the repository shows how to send each new archive elsewhere.
backups.restoreNote2: Keep the passphrase outside the platform: the copy saved in the settings is inside the encrypted archive.
backups.restoreNote3: An alert is raised when the newest archive is more than {{count}} hours old, or when a backup fails.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description_one: Who did what, when, on which team or object, from which address. No secret is ever recorded. Entries are kept {{count}} day.
audit.description_other: Who did what, when, on which team or object, from which address. No secret is ever recorded. Entries are kept {{count}} days.

actions.rescue_code_issued: Rescue code issued for an administrator
actions.access_credentials_viewed: Credentials and QR codes of an access shown
actions.letsencrypt_synced: Let's Encrypt certificate handed to TAK Server

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: Where alerts are sent. They are always shown on the monitoring page.
alerts.emails: Send alerts by e-mail to every administrator
alerts.emailsHint: Each administrator receives them in their own language.
alerts.webhookHint: Optional. Each alert raised, recalled or resolved is also posted there as a JSON document (its format is in docs/monitoring.md in the repository). Save before testing.
alerts.webhookTested: The webhook accepted the test message.
alerts.mailTestHint: Sent to your own address, in your language, through the mail server set in deploy/.env: the way sign-in codes, invitations and alerts go out.
alerts.mailTested: The mail server accepted the test e-mail for {{email}}. Check that it arrives, spam folder included.
alerts.mailTestFailed: The test e-mail could not be sent. The mail server answered:
alerts.reminder: Recall an alert that lasts every (hours)

thresholds.title: Thresholds
thresholds.description: From when something becomes an alert.
thresholds.certificate_warning_days: Announce a certificate (days before it expires)
thresholds.mail_failures_per_hour: E-mails failing from (failures in an hour)
thresholds.restart_loop_count: A service restarts in a loop from (restarts in 15 minutes)

backups.title: Backups
backups.description: The automatic backup, written on the server by the host agent.
backups.enabledHint: Switched off, no alert is raised about backups either.
backups.hourHint: The backup and the daily housekeeping start at the first look after this hour.
backups.passphraseSet: A passphrase is set: type a new one to replace it
backups.passphraseHint: At least 12 characters. Archives written from then on are encrypted with it (AES-256). It is never shown again: keep a copy outside the platform, a restore asks for it.
backups.passphraseRemoved: Passphrase removed: the next archives will not be encrypted.

other.title: Retention and TAK Server version
other.takVersion: Latest TAK Server version seen on tak.gov
other.takVersionHint: tak.gov cannot be asked automatically. Record here the version you saw there, as it is written (5.8-RELEASE-103): the monitoring page says when it is newer than the installed one. Leave empty for none.

errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: The server cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.not_found: This no longer exists, or you do not have access to it.
errors.invalid_input: Some of the information entered is not valid.
errors.invalid_email: This e-mail address is not valid.
errors.invalid_team_name: This name cannot be used for a team. Use at least two letters or digits.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a while before trying again.
errors.resend_too_soon: A code was just sent to this address. Wait a moment before asking for another one.
errors.challenge_failed: The page's security check did not go through. Please try again.
errors.invalid_code: This code is wrong or has expired. Check it, or ask for a new one.
errors.mail_unavailable: The e-mail could not be sent. Please try again in a moment.
errors.team_name_taken: A team with this name already exists.
errors.too_many_pending_requests: You already have several requests waiting. Wait for an answer before sending another one.
errors.team_already_decided: This request has already been reviewed.
errors.team_full: The team has reached its member limit.
errors.already_member: This person is already a member of the team.
errors.already_invited: This person has already been invited.
errors.invitation_not_pending: This invitation is no longer waiting for an answer.
errors.last_leader: A team needs at least one leader. Name another leader first.
errors.access_kind_not_allowed: This kind of access does not fit the team's connection mode.
errors.tak_unavailable: The TAK server cannot be reached right now. Nothing is lost: try again in a moment.
errors.directory_unavailable: The directory of the TAK server cannot be reached right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.invalid_event_name: This name cannot be used for an event. Use at least two letters or digits.
errors.invalid_event_dates: These dates are not valid: an event ends after it starts, in the future, lasts between one minute and one year, and its start cannot change once it has begun.
errors.event_name_taken: Another event that is not over has the same name. Choose another one.
errors.too_many_events: Your team already hosts too many events. End or cancel one first.
errors.event_closed: This event is over or cancelled: it can no longer be changed.
errors.event_not_running: This event has not started yet. You can cancel it instead.
errors.team_already_in_event: This team is already invited to the event, or already takes part in it.
errors.event_invitation_not_pending: This invitation is no longer waiting for an answer.
errors.internal: The server met an unexpected problem. Please try again.
errors.agent_unavailable: The host agent is not answering: nothing was done. Check it on the server (docker compose ps agent).
errors.agent_busy: The host agent is busy with another action (a backup or a restart). Try again in a moment.
errors.service_not_allowed: This service cannot be restarted from here.
errors.action_failed: The action was attempted and failed. The server's log has the reason.
errors.webhook_not_set: No webhook address is saved yet.
errors.mail_not_configured: No mail server is set (SMTP_HOST is empty in deploy/.env): no e-mail can be sent.
